name: Hophni
overview: Hophni, identified as a son of Eli, is depicted in Scripture as part of a corrupt priestly lineage that disregarded the Lord, engaging in sinful practices that defiled the worship at Shiloh. The sons of Eli, including Hophni, are described as 'sons of Belial' who exploited their priestly office by unlawfully taking portions of sacrifices, demanding raw meat and seizing offerings by force. Their actions provoked great sin before the Lord, causing Him to abhor the offerings made by the people. Ultimately, the narrative foreshadows the death of Hophni as a consequence of his sin and the judgment upon Eli's house.
